ii: II means being one more than one.
II can also mean the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number.
II means the same as two or 2 or deuce.
ii chronicles: II Chronicles is the second of two Old Testament books telling the history of Judah and Israel until the return from the Babylonian Captivity in 536 BC.
II Chronicles means the same as 2 Chronicles.
ii corinthians: II Corinthians is a New Testament book containing the second epistle from Saint Paul to the church at Corinth.
II Corinthians means the same as Second Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Corinthians or Second Epistle to the Corinthians.
ii esdras: II Esdras is an Apocryphal book of angelic revelations.
II Esdras means the same as 2 Esdras.
ii john: II John is the second New Testament epistle traditionally attributed to Saint John the Apostle.
II John means the same as Second Epistel of John.
ii kings: II Kings is the second of two Old Testament books telling the histories of the kings of Judah and Israel.
II Kings means the same as 2 Kings.
ii maccabees: II Maccabees is an Apocryphal book describing the life of Judas Maccabaeus.
II Maccabees means the same as 2 Maccabees.
ii peter: II Peter is the second New Testament book traditionally attributed to Saint Peter the Apostle.
II Peter means the same as Second Epistle of Peter.
ii samuel: II Samuel is the second of two books of the Old Testament that tell of Saul and David.
II Samuel means the same as 2 Samuel.
ii thessalonians: II Thessalonians is a New Testament book containing Saint Paul's second epistle to the Thessalonians.
II Thessalonians means the same as Second Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Thessalonians or Second Epistle to the Thessalonians.
ii timothy: II Timothy is a New Testament book containing Saint Paul's second epistle to Timothy.
II Timothy means the same as Second Epistle of Paul the Apostle to Timothy or Second Epistle to Timothy.
iii: III means being one more than two.
III can also mean the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one.
III means the same as three or 3 or trio.
iii john: III John is the third New Testament epistle traditionally attributed to Saint John the Apostle.
III John means the same as Third Epistel of John.
iis: IIS is the most notorious and possibly the most important arm of Iraq's security system.
For example: "The Iraqi Mukhabarat has been involved in numerous terrorist activities."
IIS means the same as Iraqi Intelligence Service or Iraqi Mukhabarat.
